controllerBrief:
Orchestrate the merge-plan Phase 1 sessions with proper subagent usage and worktree isolation. Operator-owned steps (not lanes): closing GitHub PRs after their branches merge, and the Phase 2 skills import. Never edit the main checkout.

{{sessionsTable}}

PR85.name: pr85-record-line-tests
PR85.brief: Land open PR #85 (edge-case tests for serve.py record_line) onto current main. Steps: git fetch origin pull/85/head into your worktree (never the main checkout); rebase/cherry-pick its commits onto your session branch; main already carries the CI-green fixes, so the PR's old red should clear — if anything is still red, fix it minimally. Verify: bash tests/run-tests.sh --filter record_line AND powershell -File tests/run-tests.ps1 -Filter 'record line'. Done means: PR #85's test coverage present on your branch, both filters green, DONE note with commit hashes. Do not merge into main yourself; the runner does that after guards.

T1.name: tier-recon
T1.brief: Recon only — resolve nothing. From main cut the trial merge of origin/tier-orchestration-2026-09-20 (tip 4b8441a; use the origin/ ref, NEVER the stale local branch name) using git merge-tree (no worktree writes) plus one --no-commit trial merge in your worktree. Write docs/handoff/tier-conflict-map.md: the expected 12 conflicts (.gitignore, README.md, catalog/{linux,macos,windows}.json, docs/README.md, lib/linux/install.sh, lib/windows/AutoOS.Install.psm1, lib/windows/AutoOS.Serve.psm1, tests/check-links.py, tests/run-tests.{ps1,sh}) classified mechanical-vs-judgement; confirm lib/linux/serve.py and web/index.html auto-merge; list the additive set (configuration/**, opencode.jsonc, docs). Abort the trial merge afterwards so your branch carries ONLY the map doc. Done means: map doc committed, trial merge aborted (git status clean of merge state).

T2.name: tier-reconcile-merge
T2.brief: Execute the tier merge on your session branch following docs/handoff/tier-conflict-map.md (read T1's DONE note first). Decisions, all binding: (1) catalog/agent-harness.json + lib/agent_harness.py stay the single source for AGENT behavior; tier configuration/** stays STANDALONE for service runtime — extend the generator with a --config-dir reader, do not absorb infra config into the harness. (2) Tier's tracked root opencode.jsonc does NOT survive as a rival source; its tier1/2/3 wiring is projected through the generator. (3) Precedence rules go in docs/decisions/0006-*.md. (4) Apply model-review items: dedicated non-writer-family reviewer profile in agent-harness.json; tier3 legs ordered for cross-family review; litellm tier2 legs gemini-first, 2-RPM mistral last. (5) The 12 known conflicts resolve with main winning on catalog/harness-generated files; replay tier's catalog additions through the generator. Forbidden: secrets, binaries, unlicensed text, touching skills/ (Phase 2), merging into main yourself. Verify before stopping: python tests/check-vendored.py, python tests/test_agent_harness.py, and both --filter runs for every file you touched. Double-run idempotency on installer paths you changed (second run reports skipped).
